title: Cosmic Goblin Conveyor
description: A surreal night scene shows rows of pink goblin-like creatures hanging from an overhead mechanical rail system against a vibrant aurora borealis and starry sky. In the foreground, two black silhouettes of a woman and child gaze upward at the spectacle, with a stylized black tree and glowing cosmic galaxy formations below.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene featuring rows of pink impish goblins with large ears hanging from an industrial overhead conveyor rail system in the night sky. Below them, two black silhouettes of a woman and child look up in wonder, a stylized black tree with crescent moon branches on the left. Vibrant green and blue aurora borealis, a black hole with red rim, and glowing spiral galaxies in yellow, pink and cyan fill the cosmic background.
